definition_zh: 分配；份额；拨给的土地；（英）小块租种地
definition_en: an amount allotted to a person or purpose, or a small plot of land rented for growing vegetables
core_image: 写着你名字的一小块地/一份额
scene: 城边空地上排着一格格的小菜园。 Grandfather grows beans on his allotment.
sceneCN: 这里的 allotment 是「小块租种地」（第 3 个义项：英国城郊分给居民种菜的地块）；句意是爷爷在他的租种地上种豆子。

derivatives.zh: 基础动词，义为「分配；拨给」
拉丁同族名词，义为「配给；拨款」，更常用于经济语境

senses.title: The act of allotting
senses.definition: the act or process of allotting shares, funds, or tasks
senses.definitionCN: 分配份额、资金或任务的行为或过程
senses.example: The allotment of duties took all morning.
senses.exampleCN: 分派任务花了整个上午。
senses.why: The -ment suffix turns the verb allot into the action or its result.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -ment 把动词 allot 转为动作或其结果。

senses.title: The share or amount allotted
senses.definition: the amount or quota allotted to a person, unit, or purpose
senses.definitionCN: 分给个人、单位或用途的数量或配额
senses.example: His allotment of grain was cut in half.
senses.exampleCN: 他的粮食配给被削减了一半。
senses.why: From the act to its concrete result: what you receive.
senses.whyCN: 由动作转到具体结果：你实际得到的份。

senses.title: A British vegetable plot for rent
senses.definition: in Britain, a small plot of land rented from a council for growing vegetables
senses.definitionCN: 英国指从市政租来种菜的小块土地
senses.example: There is a waiting list for allotments in the town.
senses.exampleCN: 镇上的租种地要排队等候。
senses.why: Land was literally allotted to townspeople; the grant hardened into the place name.
senses.whyCN: 土地确曾分配给市民；这种授予固化成了地名性的用法。

senses.title: A grant of land to a person or group
senses.definition: an official grant of land, especially historically to Native Americans or settlers
senses.definitionCN: 官方拨予的土地，尤指历史上给原住民或移民的份地
senses.example: Each family received a land allotment.
senses.exampleCN: 每户家庭获得一份拨地。
senses.why: The legal act of allotting land left a noun for the granted parcel itself.
senses.whyCN: 拨地这一法律行为留下了指称所拨地块本身的名词。

senses.title: A share of stock in issue
senses.definition: shares of a new issue assigned to an applicant
senses.definitionCN: 新股发行中分派给申购者的股份
senses.example: Her application got a small allotment of shares.
senses.exampleCN: 她的申购获得了少量股份配售。
senses.why: Finance keeps the drawing-of-lots flavor in distributing new issues.
senses.whyCN: 金融领域的配售保留了抽签分配的味道。

senses.title: A soldier's pay assigned to family
senses.definition: a portion of a soldier's pay assigned to dependents
senses.definitionCN: 军人薪饷中划给家属的部分
senses.example: He sent a monthly allotment home.
senses.exampleCN: 他每月往家里汇津贴。
senses.why: A fixed share of income formally assigned to someone.
senses.whyCN: 收入中被正式指派给某人的固定份额。

senses.title: A time allotment in schedules
senses.definition: a fixed amount of time set aside for an activity
senses.definitionCN: 为某活动设定的固定时长
senses.example: The exam's time allotment is three hours.
senses.exampleCN: 考试时间配额为三小时。
senses.why: The share logic extends neatly to clock time.
senses.whyCN: 份额逻辑顺延到钟表时间上。

senses.title: The distribution principle itself
senses.definition: allotment as a principle or system of distributing limited resources
senses.definitionCN: 分配有限资源的配给原则或制度
senses.example: The tribe opposed the allotment system.
senses.exampleCN: 部落反对配给制度。
senses.why: A repeated act can be discussed as an abstract system.
senses.whyCN: 反复进行的动作可被抽象为一种制度来讨论。

intro.en: Allotment is allot plus the noun suffix -ment, formed in English in the fifteenth century.
intro.cn: allotment 由 allot 加名词后缀 -ment 构成，十五世纪成形于英语。

items.en: Reconstructed *hluta-, "share by lot", behind lot.
items.cn: lot 背后的重构词形 *hluta-「抽签之份」。

items.en: hlot, the drawn object deciding shares.
items.cn: 古英语 hlot，定份额的抽签物。

items.en: allot formed from a- + lot.
items.cn: 中古英语由 a- + lot 构成 allot。

items.en: -ment, borrowed via French from Latin -mentum.
items.cn: 后缀 -ment 经法语借自拉丁语 -mentum。

items.en: allotment first records the act of allotting.
items.cn: allotment 最初记录「分配」这一动作。

items.en: Senses cover quotas, British garden plots, and land grants.
items.cn: 义项涵盖配额、英国租种地与拨地。

note.en: Allotment competes with allocation in formal use, and pairs historically with the draw of lots.
note.cn: 正式语体中 allotment 与 allocation 相竞争，历史上与抽签搭配。

entries.definition: the base verb "to allot".
entries.definitionCN: 基础动词「分配」。

entries.definition: court-ordered support payments; shares the al- spelling but a Latin root meaning nourish.
entries.definitionCN: 赡养费；拼法相近，但来自拉丁语「养育」词根，无关联。

entries.definition: shares the -ment suffix pattern, unrelated root.
entries.definitionCN: 共享 -ment 后缀模式，词根无关。

entries.definition: the Latin-rooted synonym, favored in economics.
entries.definitionCN: 拉丁词源近义词，多用于经济学。

entries.definition: a fixed share assigned, especially as a minimum.
entries.definitionCN: 被指定的固定份额，尤指最低限额。

entries.definition: a fixed allowance of food or supplies.
entries.definitionCN: 食物或补给的固定配给量。

normalIntro.en: Remember allotment as allot + -ment and its British garden life.
normalIntro.cn: 把 allotment 记成 allot + -ment，以及它在英国的菜园生活。

normal.en: allot + -ment: the act or result of allotting.
normal.cn: allot + -ment：分配的动作或结果。

normal.en: British image: rows of vegetable plots at the edge of town.
normal.cn: 英式画面：城边一排排菜地。

normal.en: Pair: allot (verb) → allotment (noun), like assign → assignment.
normal.cn: 配对：allot → allotment，如 assign → assignment。

normal.en: Finance: allotment of shares in a new issue.
normal.cn: 金融：新股的配售份额。

normal.en: History: land allotments to settlers and Native Americans.
normal.cn: 历史：拨给移民与原住民的土地。

abstract.en: A mailbox slot with your name and a fixed number of coins inside.
abstract.cn: 一个写着你名字的信箱格，里面躺着固定数目的硬币。

abstract.en: A row of tidy garden plots, each with a wooden sign.
abstract.cn: 一排整齐的菜地，每块地都插着木牌。

abstract.en: A clock sliced into labeled wedges of time.
abstract.cn: 钟面被切成标好用途的时间楔块。

examples.en: Each member's allotment of ballots was two.
examples.cn: 每位成员的选票配额是两张。

examples.en: They spent Sunday digging the allotment.
examples.cn: 他们周日花时间翻整租种地。

examples.en: The allotment of funds favors rural schools.
examples.cn: 资金分配向乡村学校倾斜。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿老门特」——阿婆说“老人也有份”，门特（-ment）一开，人人一份不落空。

sensesIntro.en: The -ment noun starts with the act of allotting, then covers the share received, British garden plots, land grants, share issues, army pay, time quotas, and the system itself.
sensesIntro.cn: -ment 名词从分配行为出发，继而涵盖所得份额、英式菜地、拨地、股份配售、军属津贴、时间配额，直至制度本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a share with your name fixed on it
core.cn: 核心意象：写着你名字、被固定下来的份额

branches.en: The act and the share it produces.
branches.cn: 分配行为及其产生的份额。

branches.en: British garden plots and official land grants.
branches.cn: 英式菜地与官方拨地。

branches.en: Shares in a stock issue.
branches.cn: 新股配售份额。

branches.en: Pay assigned to dependents.

branches.en: Time quotas and the distribution system.

intro.cn: allotment 是简单的动词加后缀派生。

latinIntro.en: Only the suffix is Latin; the core is Germanic lot.
latinIntro.cn: 只有后缀是拉丁来源；核心是日耳曼的 lot。

definition_zh: 孢子；（细菌的）芽孢
definition_en: a single reproductive cell of fungi, ferns, mosses or bacteria that can grow into a new individual
core_image: 蕨叶背面的褐色小点裂开，细到看不见的粉末被风带走
scene: 蕨叶背面排列着一圈褐色的小点，手指一碰便有细粉落下。 Each spore is a single cell that can grow into a new plant without any partner.
sceneCN: 这里 spore 指「孢子」（第 1 个义项：能单独长成新个体的繁殖细胞）；句意为每个孢子都是一个单细胞，无需任何伙伴就能长成新植株。

senses.title: A reproductive cell of fungi or ferns
senses.titleCN: 真菌或蕨类的繁殖细胞
senses.definition: a single cell that can develop into a new individual without fusing with another cell
senses.definitionCN: 无需与另一个细胞融合就能发育成新个体的单细胞
senses.example: Each spore can grow into a new plant on its own.
senses.exampleCN: 每个孢子都能独自长成一株新植物。
senses.why: the word names a unit of reproduction that needs no partner, which is what separates it from a seed.
senses.whyCN: 这个词命名一种无需伙伴的繁殖单元，这正是它与种子的分界。

senses.title: A bacterial endospore
senses.definition: a tough resting body formed inside a bacterium to survive hard conditions
senses.definitionCN: 细菌内部形成的坚韧休眠体，用以度过恶劣条件
senses.example: The spore survives boiling and returns to growth later.
senses.exampleCN: 芽孢能挺过煮沸，之后重新生长。
senses.why: the same noun covers the bacterial case because both are resistant single-cell stages.
senses.whyCN: 同一个名词覆盖细菌情形，因为二者都是抗逆的单细胞阶段。

senses.title: The dust on a fern's frond
senses.definition: the small brown bodies clustered under a fern leaf
senses.definitionCN: 聚在蕨叶背面小片上的褐色颗粒
senses.example: The brown spots under the frond are clusters of spores.
senses.exampleCN: 叶背的褐色斑点是成簇的孢子。
senses.why: visible fern spores are the everyday sight that fixed the word's popular meaning.
senses.whyCN: 可见的蕨孢子正是固定这个词通俗含义的日常景象。

senses.title: A mushroom's spore print
senses.definition: the pattern left when a mushroom cap drops its spores onto paper
senses.definitionCN: 蘑菇菌盖把孢子落在纸上留下的图案
senses.example: The spore print was white, which narrowed the identification.
senses.exampleCN: 孢子印是白色的，这缩小了鉴定范围。
senses.why: the print makes invisible spores visible, so the noun names a diagnostic tool as well.
senses.whyCN: 孢子印让看不见的孢子变得可见，因此名词也命名一种鉴定工具。

senses.title: Of bacteria that form spores
senses.definition: used of species that can build a resistant spore inside the cell
senses.definitionCN: 用于能在细胞内形成抗逆芽孢的物种
senses.example: Spore-forming bacteria survived the cleaning cycle.
senses.exampleCN: 产孢细菌挺过了清洗循环。
senses.why: the compound adjective uses spore as a classifying feature, not as an object.
senses.whyCN: 复合形容词把孢子作为分类特征，而非作为对象。

senses.title: A unit that travels through air
senses.titleCN: 随气流传播的繁殖单元
senses.definition: a reproductive body adapted to be carried by wind or animals
senses.definitionCN: 适应由风或动物携带的繁殖体
senses.example: Spore dispersal lets a fungus reach a new log before the old one decays.
senses.exampleCN: 孢子传播让真菌在老木腐坏之前抵达新木。
senses.why: size and weight make spores travellers, so the noun also names a dispersal stage.
senses.whyCN: 大小与重量使孢子成为旅者，因此名词也命名一个传播阶段。

senses.title: A moss spore from a capsule
senses.definition: a cell released from the capsule of a moss or liverwort
senses.definitionCN: 从苔藓或地钱蒴果中释放的细胞
senses.example: Moss spores need a damp surface before they will grow.
senses.exampleCN: 苔藓孢子需要湿润表面才会生长。
senses.why: mosses repeat the fern pattern with a capsule, so the general noun covers both groups.
senses.whyCN: 苔藓用蒴果重复蕨类的模式，因此通名覆盖两类。

senses.title: A dormant stage that waits
senses.definition: a spore in a paused state that resumes growth when conditions improve
senses.definitionCN: 处于暂停状态、条件改善后恢复生长的孢子
senses.example: The dormant spore waited in the soil for years.
senses.exampleCN: 休眠孢子在土壤里等了多年。
senses.why: waiting is the whole point of the bacterial spore, and the noun is used for that pause as well.
senses.whyCN: 等待正是细菌芽孢存在的全部意义，名词也因此用于这段暂停。

intro.en: Spore comes from Greek spora 'a sowing, seed, offspring', related to speirein 'to sow, scatter'. It entered scientific English in the nineteenth century through Modern Latin spora. The deeper origin is reconstructed.
intro.cn: spore 来自希腊 spora「播种、种子、后代」，与 speirein「播撒」相关；19 世纪经近代拉丁 spora 进入科学英语。更早来源属重构。

items.en: Spora meant 'a sowing' and by extension 'seed, offspring'; the image is scattering rather than enclosing.
items.cn: spora 意为「播种」，引申为「种子、后代」；意象是撒播，而非包裹。

items.en: Speirein 'to sow, scatter' is the verb behind spora; the two words are generally treated as related within Greek.
items.cn: speirein「播种、撒播」是 spora 背后的动词；在希腊语内部二者一般被视为相关。

items.en: An Indo-European root meaning 'to strew' is reconstructed for this family; it is a reconstruction, not a recorded form.
items.cn: 这一词族常被重构出一个意为「撒布」的印欧词根；这是重构形式，并非有记录的形式。

items.en: Modern Latin adopted spora for the reproductive bodies of cryptogams, and English took the word in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 近代拉丁采用 spora 指隐花植物的繁殖体，英语在 19 世纪引入这个词。

items.en: Microbiology later applied spore to the heat-resistant body inside a bacterium, extending the word to a different kingdom.
items.cn: 微生物学后来把 spore 用于细菌内部的耐热体，使这个词跨到另一个界。

items.en: Source uncertain (first botanical date): the first English use for fern and fungus bodies is not precisely dated here; the Greek-to-Latin route is clear but the earliest citation is not.
items.cn: 来源不确定（植物学义首见年代）：英语首次用于蕨与真菌繁殖体的时间在此未能确证；希腊到拉丁的路径清楚，最早书证则不确定。

note.en: Group one separates the spore family by word class; group two separates single-celled reproductive units from seeds and from bacterial resting bodies.
note.cn: 第一组按词类区分 spore 词族；第二组区分单细胞繁殖单元与种子及细菌休眠体。

entries.definition: The forming of spores; the noun names the event, while spore names the product.
entries.definitionCN: 孢子的形成；名词命名事件，而 spore 命名产物。

entries.definition: To form spores; it is what the organism does before any spore exists.
entries.definitionCN: 形成孢子；这是生物在孢子出现之前所做的事。

entries.definition: The structure that produces and holds spores, formed with Greek angeion 'vessel'.
entries.definitionCN: 产生并容纳孢子的结构，由希腊 angeion「容器」构成。

entries.definition: From Greek sperma 'seed', a different noun from spora, though both belong to the same sowing image.
entries.definitionCN: 来自希腊 sperma「种子」，与 spora 是不同名词，尽管都属同一「播种」意象。

entries.definition: A fertilised unit with an embryo, food store and coat; a spore is usually one cell with no stored food.
entries.definitionCN: 含胚、养分与种皮的受精单元；孢子通常是单细胞且不储养分。

entries.definition: The specific heat-resistant body inside a bacterium; it is a kind of spore, named with endo- 'within'.
entries.definitionCN: 细菌内部特定的耐热体；它是孢子的一种，由 endo-「在内」命名。

entries.definition: The male gamete-bearing grain of a flower; unlike a spore, it must reach an egg to produce anything.
entries.definitionCN: 花中携带雄配子的颗粒；与孢子不同，它必须到达卵才能产生新个体。

entries.definition: A resistant resting stage of some protozoa or insects, not a reproductive cell in the spore sense.
entries.definitionCN: 某些原生动物或昆虫的抗逆休眠阶段，并非孢子意义上的繁殖细胞。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Greek root, the real microbiological phrases and the real relatives.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的希腊词根、真实的微生物学搭配与真实同族词。

normal.en: spora 'sowing' + the scientific ending: the scattered unit.
normal.cn: spora「播种」加科学词尾：被撒播的单元。

normal.en: One cell, no partner: that is what makes a spore a spore.
normal.cn: 一个细胞，无需伙伴：这正是孢子之为孢子。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: fungal spore, bacterial spore, spore print, spore dispersal.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：真菌孢子、细菌芽孢、孢子印、孢子传播。

normal.en: The family runs sporulation, sporulate, sporangium, sporophyte.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 sporulation、sporulate、sporangium、sporophyte。

normal.en: Ferns show it as brown dots; mushrooms show it as a print.
normal.cn: 蕨类把它显成褐点，蘑菇把它显成印痕。

abstract.en: Picture dust that needs no partner and can wait for years.
abstract.cn: 想象一种不需要伙伴、能等待多年的尘埃。

abstract.en: Picture a sealed capsule opening only when the air turns damp.
abstract.cn: 想象一个只在空气转湿时才打开的密封蒴果。

abstract.en: Picture a message so light that the wind carries it without effort.
abstract.cn: 想象一则轻得让风毫不费力就能带走的讯息。

examples.en: Fungal spores spread through the greenhouse in a single day.
examples.cn: 真菌孢子在一天之内传遍温室。

examples.en: The spore print helped identify the mushroom.
examples.cn: 孢子印帮助鉴定了这种蘑菇。

examples.en: Spore-forming bacteria can survive drying for decades.
examples.cn: 产孢细菌能在干燥环境中存活数十年。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「spor（撒播）+ e」——被风吹散的单细胞 → 孢子

root: 希腊 spora「播种、种子、后代」← speirein「播撒」；近代拉丁 spora → 英语 spore。其印欧词根常重构为意为「撒布」的形式。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of spore all describe one light, self-sufficient cell: it is scattered, waits, and then grows without needing a partner.
sensesIntro.cn: spore 的八个义项都描述同一个轻而自足的细胞：它被撒散、等待，然后在无需伙伴的情况下生长。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: brown dust falling from a fern frond into the wind.
core.cn: 核心意象：褐色粉末从蕨叶落进风里。

branches.en: PLANT AND MOSS CASES: ferns and mosses release the same kind of cell.
branches.cn: 蕨与苔藓：两类植物释放同一种细胞。

branches.en: THE BACTERIAL CASE: the spore is a tough body that waits.
branches.cn: 细菌情形：孢子是等待中的坚韧体。

branches.en: IDENTIFICATION AND CLASSIFICATION: the print names a species, the trait names a group.
branches.cn: 鉴定与分类：印痕命名物种，特征命名类群。

branches.en: TRAVEL: lightness is the adaptation that lets it leave.
branches.cn: 旅行：轻是让它得以离开的适应。

branches.en: THE KEY CONTRAST: no partner is needed, unlike pollen or a sperm.
branches.cn: 关键对照：与花粉或精子不同，它不需要伙伴。

intro.en: Spore is a Greek noun taken into scientific Latin, so its family is built with Greek and Latin elements rather than Germanic ones.
intro.cn: spore 是进入科学拉丁语的希腊名词，其词族由希腊与拉丁成分构成，而非日耳曼成分。

latinIntro.en: Greek spora 'sowing' passed into Modern Latin as spora; sporula is its diminutive, and sporulatio names the forming of spores.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊 spora「播种」作为 spora 进入近代拉丁语；sporula 是其指小形式，sporulatio 命名孢子的形成。

items.example: The root names scattering rather than enclosing.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根命名撒播，而非包裹。

items.example: Spore keeps the Latin singular in English.

The sporophyte is the visible fern plant.

definition_zh: 例如；比如；举例来说（多用于书面与正式场合）
definition_en: used to introduce an example of what has just been said, especially in writing
core_image: 报告页边一支箭头，从概括的句子指向一个具体案例
scene: 报告写到第三页时需要具体案例，作者在句首另起一行给出。 For example, the coastal town lost two metres of beach in a decade.
sceneCN: 这里取第 2 个义项（句首用于书面说明与学术写作）；句意为例如，这座海滨小镇十年间失去了两米海滩。

pos.zh: 副词性短语：例如；比如；举例来说

collocations.phrase: for example in the case of

derivatives.zh: 由拉丁语表示「取出样本」的名词经法语进入英语，义为「例子；范例；榜样」
由该名词加复数词尾构成，义为「多个例子」
由同族拉丁词干加动词词尾构成，义为「举例说明；是……的典型」
由该动词加表示动作结果的名词词尾构成，义为「举例说明；例证」
由同族词干加形容词词尾构成，义为「模范的；可作范例的」
由同族词干加名词词尾构成，义为「范例；典型」

senses.title: One case that shows the point
senses.definition: to name one case that shows what the previous statement means
senses.definitionCN: 举出一个事例，使前面的说法变得明白
senses.example: Some fuels burn cleanly; natural gas, for example, produces little soot.
senses.exampleCN: 有些燃料燃烧洁净，例如天然气产生的烟尘很少。
senses.why: The noun example names something taken out as a sample, so the phrase hands over one sample of the claim.
senses.whyCN: 「例子」本指被取出来作样本的东西，因此这个短语就是交出一个样本作证。

senses.title: Sentence-initial in written prose
senses.definition: placed at the head of a sentence in reports and academic writing
senses.definitionCN: 放在句首，用于报告与学术写作中
senses.example: For example, a two-line change in the code fixed the whole error.
senses.exampleCN: 例如，代码里改了两行就解决了整个错误。
senses.why: Written English likes a clear signpost at the start of the sentence, and this phrase supplies it.
senses.whyCN: 书面英语喜欢在句首放一个清楚的指路牌，这个短语正好充当。

senses.title: Parenthetical inside a clause
senses.definition: inserted between commas after a noun to add one illustrative case
senses.definitionCN: 用逗号插在名词之后，补上一个说明性的例子
senses.example: The older workers, for example the machinists, knew the old lathes best.
senses.exampleCN: 老工人，例如机械工，最熟悉那些旧车床。
senses.why: A parenthesis keeps the main clause intact while one case is slipped in beside it.
senses.whyCN: 插入语让主句保持完整，同时把一个例子塞到旁边。

senses.title: A typical representative
senses.definition: used of a case that is typical of its class rather than merely one of many
senses.definitionCN: 用于某一类中具有典型性、而非随便一个的事例
senses.example: A typical port, for example Rotterdam, handles millions of containers a year.
senses.exampleCN: 一座典型港口，例如鹿特丹，每年处理数百万个集装箱。
senses.why: Some examples are chosen because they are ordinary, and the phrase then carries the sense of a model case.
senses.whyCN: 有些例子之所以被选中，是因为它们平常而典型，此时这个短语带有「样板」的意味。

senses.title: Explaining a technical term
senses.definition: introduces a familiar instance that explains a technical name
senses.definitionCN: 引出一个熟悉的实例，用来说明一个专业名称
senses.example: A catalyst, for example platinum, speeds a reaction without being consumed.
senses.exampleCN: 催化剂，例如铂，能加快反应而自身不被消耗。
senses.why: Technical writing defines by naming one known member, which is the work this phrase does.
senses.whyCN: 技术写作常用一个已知成员来下定义，这正是这个短语所做的事。

senses.title: Appositive specification
senses.definition: placed after a category noun to specify one member of it
senses.definitionCN: 放在类别名词之后，点明其中一个成员
senses.example: Root vegetables, for example carrots, store sugar underground.
senses.exampleCN: 根类蔬菜，例如胡萝卜，把糖分储存在地下。
senses.why: The phrase can act almost like a colon, turning a broad label into a visible object.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语几乎能起冒号的作用，把宽泛的标签变成一个看得见的对象。

senses.title: Illustration in a lecture
senses.definition: used in a talk to pause and place a concrete case before the audience
senses.definitionCN: 在讲演中稍作停顿，把一个具体案例摆到听众面前
senses.example: For example, imagine a queue at a single ticket window.
senses.exampleCN: 例如，设想只有一个售票窗口前的长队。
senses.why: A speaker needs to slow down and give the ear a picture, and the phrase marks that pause.
senses.whyCN: 讲者需要放慢速度给耳朵一幅画面，这个短语就标出那次停顿。

senses.title: Spelling out the written marker
senses.definition: used in formal prose instead of the abbreviated Latin marker found in notes
senses.definitionCN: 正式文章中把标记写全，而不用注释里的拉丁缩写
senses.example: Journals often spell out for example rather than use the abbreviation in running text.
senses.exampleCN: 期刊在正文里常把这个短语写全，而不用缩写。
senses.why: Running text avoids abbreviations that belong to notes, so the full phrase becomes the formal choice.
senses.whyCN: 正文回避属于注释的缩写，于是写全的短语成为正式选择。

intro.en: For example joins the native preposition for with example, a noun from Latin exemplum, something taken out as a sample, built on eximere, to take out. French carried the noun into English.
intro.cn: 这个短语由本土介词与「例子」一词合成；后者出自拉丁语中意为「取出作样本之物」的名词，其动词意为「取出」，经法语进入英语。

items.en: For marked cause, purpose or the ground of a statement, a role it keeps in the phrase.
items.cn: 这个词标记原因、目的或立论的依据，这一角色在短语里保留至今。

items.en: Eximere meant to take out, from ex, out, and emere, to take or buy.
items.cn: 这个动词意为取出，由表示「向外」的前缀与表示「拿、买」的词构成。

items.en: Exemplum named a sample, a copy or a precedent, the thing taken out of a larger stock.
items.cn: 这个名词指样本、副本或先例，即从更大的一批中取出之物。

items.en: French reshaped the noun and passed it to English; the English spelling settled later.
items.cn: 法语改造了这个名词并传入英语，英语的拼写后来才固定。

items.en: English used the noun for a case that illustrates a rule; its exact first date is uncertain.
items.cn: 英语用这个名词指说明规则的事例；其确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: The phrase became the standard written marker for illustration, slightly more formal than its spoken twin.
items.cn: 这个短语成为书面举例的标准标记，比口语中的同义说法略正式。

note.en: The first group shares the noun or its word family; the second group names other ways of pointing to an instance.
note.cn: 第一组共享同一个名词或其词族；第二组是指向实例的其他说法。

entries.definition: The same job in a slightly lighter, more conversational key.
entries.definitionCN: 做同一件事，语气更轻、更口语化的同义短语。

entries.definition: The noun inside the phrase, naming a sample or a model.
entries.definitionCN: 短语内部的名词，指样本或范例。

entries.definition: The plural of the noun, used when several cases are named.
entries.definitionCN: 该名词的复数，用来指同时举出的多个例子。

entries.definition: The verb built on the same stem, meaning to illustrate by example.
entries.definitionCN: 由同一词干构成的动词，义为举例说明。

entries.definition: An adjective from the same family, meaning fit to serve as a model.
entries.definitionCN: 同族的形容词，义为可作模范的。

entries.definition: Introduces members of a category, usually with no comma before a short list.
entries.definitionCN: 引出类别的成员作例子，短列举前通常不加逗号。

entries.definition: Specifies exactly what was referred to, not merely one instance of it.
entries.definitionCN: 精确点明所指为何，而不只是给出其中一个实例。

entries.definition: Marks items as part of a larger set rather than as illustrations of a rule.
entries.definitionCN: 把若干项标为更大集合的一部分，而不是作为规则的例证。

entries.definition: A verb phrase that announces illustration and ties it to the argument.
entries.definitionCN: 一个动词短语，预告举例并把例子与论证绑在一起。

entries.definition: One strong case offered as direct support for the point just made.
entries.definitionCN: 指有力支持前面论点的单一事例。

normalIntro.en: The phrase literally offers one sample taken out of a larger stock: for the purpose of showing a case.
normalIntro.cn: 这个短语字面上就是从更大一批里取出一个样本，用来展示一个事例。

normal.en: An arrow in the margin from a general sentence to one concrete case.
normal.cn: 页边的一支箭头，从概括的句子指向一个具体案例。

normal.en: The Latin noun meant a sample taken out of the heap, so the phrase lifts one case out.
normal.cn: 拉丁名词本指从一堆里取出的样本，所以这个短语是把一个例子拎出来。

normal.en: Written prose likes it at the head of the sentence, with a comma right after.
normal.cn: 书面文章喜欢把它放在句首，并在其后加逗号。

normal.en: It is the formal twin of the conversational phrase; the two do the same work.
normal.cn: 它是口语同义短语的正式版本，两者做同一件事。

normal.en: The words never change shape, whatever the sentence does around them.
normal.cn: 无论周围的句子怎么变，这两个词本身从不改变形态。

abstract.en: An example is a controlled experiment run inside an argument.
abstract.cn: 例子是在论证内部做的一次受控实验。

abstract.en: To illustrate is to lend one visible object to an invisible claim.
abstract.cn: 举例就是把一个看得见的物件借给一个看不见的论断。

abstract.en: The shorter the phrase, the more the writer trusts the reader to see the pattern.
abstract.cn: 短语越短，作者就越相信读者能自己看出其中的模式。

examples.en: For example, the oldest trees in the valley survived the drought.
examples.cn: 例如，谷地里最老的树熬过了那场干旱。

examples.en: A good report gives one case, for example a failed pump, before stating the rule.
examples.cn: 好的报告会先给出一个案例，比如一台失效的泵，再陈述规律。

examples.en: For example, the coastal town lost two metres of beach in a decade.
examples.cn: 例如，这座海滨小镇十年间失去了两米海滩。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「佛 爱克桑普」——「佛」起话头，「爱克桑普」就是摆出来的那个样本：例如、举例来说

root: 由古英语表原因的介词「为了」与经法语借自拉丁语、原义为「取出作样本之物」的名词合成；固定短语的确切书面首见年代不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses range from one illustrative case to sentence-initial use, parenthetical use, a typical model, a term explained, an appositive, lecture illustration and the written marker itself.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从用一个例子说明观点，依次延伸到句首书面用法、插入语、典型代表、术语解释、同位语具体化、讲授举例与写全标记本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a margin arrow running from a general sentence to one concrete case.
core.cn: 核心意象：页边一支箭头，从概括的句子指向一个具体案例。

branches.en: THE TYPICAL CASE: one representative sample carries the general claim.
branches.cn: 典型例子：一个有代表性的样本承载总体说法。

branches.en: THE OPENING MOVE: the phrase starts a sentence in writing or in a lecture.
branches.cn: 开篇动作：在书面或讲授中把短语置于句首。

branches.en: THE CASE BESIDE THE NOUN: a parenthesis or an appositive narrows a broad label.
branches.cn: 贴在名词旁边的例子：插入语或同位语把宽泛标签具体化。

branches.en: THE TERM MADE PLAIN: a familiar instance explains a technical name.
branches.cn: 术语变得浅白：一个熟悉的实例解释专业名称。

branches.en: THE WRITTEN MARKER ITSELF: formal prose spells the phrase out instead of abbreviating.
branches.cn: 书面标记本身：正式文章把短语写全，而不用缩写。

intro.en: The phrase combines a native preposition with a Latin noun that came through French. Its parts are still transparent to a modern reader.
intro.cn: 这个短语把一个本土介词与一个经法语而来的拉丁名词组合在一起，各部分对今天的读者仍然一目了然。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries are the verb eximere and the noun exemplum; the noun is the direct source of the English word example.
latinIntro.cn: 列出的拉丁词条是动词与名词，其中名词是英语「例子」一词的直接来源。

items.example: It gives the phrase its purpose.
items.exampleCN: 它给这个短语提供目的。

items.structure: English noun from French and Latin
items.example: The noun carries the case being offered.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词承载被举出的那个例子。

items.meaning: a sample, a copy, a precedent
items.example: It is the direct source of example.
items.exampleCN: 它是英语「例子」一词的直接来源。
这个动词构成了拉丁名词。

items.example: It marks the act of taking something out.
items.exampleCN: 它标记「把某物取出来」的动作。

items.example: It forms a neuter noun from a verb stem.
items.exampleCN: 它由动词词干构成中性名词。

items.example: The verb form does the work of the phrase in one word.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词用一个词完成了该短语的工作。

items.example: It does the same work in speech.
items.exampleCN: 它在口语中做同样的工作。

items.example: It belongs in notes rather than in running prose.
items.exampleCN: 它属于注释，而不属于正文。

latinEntries.meaning: a sample, a copy, a precedent

definition_zh: 每四年一次的；持续四年的；四周年纪念
definition_en: happening once every four years, or lasting four years
core_image: 日历上每隔四个数字出现一个红色标记
scene: 奥运会每四年举办一次，主办城市往往提前七年就开始准备。 The games are quadrennial, and the host city often begins preparing seven years ahead.
sceneCN: 这里 quadrennial 指每四年一次的（第 1 个义项：四年一届）；句意为奥运会每四年举办一次，主办城市往往提前七年就开始准备。

senses.title: Every four years
senses.definition: taking place once in every four-year interval
senses.definitionCN: 每隔四年发生一次
senses.example: The games are quadrennial, and the host city often begins preparing seven years ahead.
senses.exampleCN: 奥运会每四年举办一次，主办城市往往提前七年就开始准备。
senses.why: The adjective counts recurrence, and the interval is a fixed calendar unit.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词计算重现的频率，而那个间隔是固定的日历单位。

senses.title: A four-year term
senses.definition: lasting for a period of four years
senses.definitionCN: 持续四年的期限
senses.example: The quadrennial term ends with the same ceremony every time.
senses.exampleCN: 这个四年任期每次都随着同一场仪式结束。
senses.why: Here the same four years measure duration rather than interval, which is why terms and plans take the word.
senses.whyCN: 这里的同一个四年衡量的是长度而非间隔，所以任期与计划也用这个词。

senses.title: A quadrennial
senses.definition: the noun for a fourth anniversary or the ceremony marking it
senses.definitionCN: 名词，指第四个周年或为它举行的仪式
senses.example: The town held a quadrennial for its founding, with four candles on the cake.
senses.exampleCN: 小镇为建镇举行四周年纪念，蛋糕上插了四支蜡烛。
senses.why: The noun turns the interval into a date on the calendar rather than a schedule of recurrence.
senses.whyCN: 名词义项把这个间隔变成日历上的一个日子，而不是一份重现的日程。

intro.en: Quadrennial joins Latin quadri-, 'four', to annus, 'year', with the adjective ending -ial.
intro.cn: quadrennial 把拉丁语 quadri-（四）与 annus（年）结合，再加形容词词尾 -ial。

items.en: Quadri- was the combining form of four.
items.cn: quadri- 是「四」的组合形式。

items.en: Annus meant year, the base of annual and anniversary.
items.cn: annus 意为年，是 annual 与 anniversary 的词根。

items.en: A quadrennium was a space of four years.
items.cn: quadrennium 指四年的时段。

items.en: English formed quadrennial for four-year cycles.
items.cn: 英语造出 quadrennial，指四年的周期。

items.en: Elections and games fixed the word in public life.
items.cn: 选举与运动会把这个词固定在公共生活里。

note.en: The look-alike group is other quadr- compounds; the near-meaning group is the -ennial counting family.
note.cn: 形近组是其它 quadr 复合词；近义组是 -ennial 计数家族。

entries.definition: a quarter of a circle.
entries.definitionCN: 圆形的四分之一。

entries.definition: a four-sided courtyard.
entries.definitionCN: 四面围合的庭院。

entries.definition: the four-headed thigh muscle.
entries.definitionCN: 股四头肌。

entries.definition: to multiply by four.
entries.definitionCN: 使成为四倍。

entries.definition: every two years.
entries.definitionCN: 每两年一次的。

entries.definition: every three years.
entries.definitionCN: 每三年一次的。

entries.definition: every year.
entries.definitionCN: 每年的。

entries.definition: lasting or recurring year after year.
entries.definitionCN: 常年不断的。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a calendar with a red mark every fourth year.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「日历上每逢第四年出现一个红标记」的画面。

normal.en: Quadrennial holds quadri, four, and annus, year: four years in one word.
normal.cn: quadrennial 里有 quadri（四）和 annus（年）：一个词装四年。

normal.en: Picture a stadium that wakes up only when three years have passed.
normal.cn: 想象一座体育场，只有过了三年才醒来一次。

normal.en: Say kwa-DREN-ee-al; the middle sounds like drain, years draining away.
normal.cn: 读 kwa-DREN-ee-al，中间像 drain，年份在流走。

normal.en: The -ennial ending is a ladder: biennial, triennial, quadrennial.
normal.cn: 词尾 -ennial 是一把梯子：两年、三年、四年。

normal.en: The noun quadrennium names the whole four-year block.
normal.cn: 名词 quadrennium 命名整个四年区块。

abstract.en: A quadrennial rhythm makes patience into an institution.
abstract.cn: 四年的节律把耐心变成一种制度。

abstract.en: The word measures time in blocks large enough to plan and small enough to remember.
abstract.cn: 这个词用足够规划、又足够记住的时间块来衡量。

abstract.en: Naming an interval is a way of agreeing when the next argument happens.
abstract.cn: 命名一个间隔，就是约定下一次争论何时发生。

examples.en: The games are quadrennial, and the host city often begins preparing seven years ahead.
examples.cn: 奥运会每四年举办一次，主办城市往往提前七年就开始准备。

examples.en: The quadrennial review decides which programmes continue.
examples.cn: 四年期审查决定哪些项目继续。

examples.en: A biennial fair comes twice as often as a quadrennial one.
examples.cn: 两年一次的博览会，频率是四年一次的两倍。

dict_mnemonic.text: quadri（四）+ enn（年）+ ial → 每四年一次的。

root: 拉丁语 quadri-（四）+ annus（年）+ 形容词词尾 -ial

sensesIntro.en: The three senses count the same four years as an interval between events, as a length of office, and as a date to be celebrated.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项数的是同一个四年：两次事件之间的间隔、一段任职的长度，以及一个要庆祝的日子。

core.en: A RED MARK EVERY FOURTH YEAR
core.cn: 每逢第四年出现的一道红标记

branches.en: Games and elections that return on a fixed cycle.
branches.cn: 按固定周期回归的运动会与选举。

branches.en: The return read as a rhythm rather than a single event.
branches.cn: 把回归读成节律而不是单个事件。

branches.en: A term whose length is four years.
branches.cn: 长度为四年的任期。

branches.en: A fourth anniversary and its ceremony.
branches.cn: 第四个周年与它的仪式。

branches.en: An interval counted and then dated.
branches.cn: 先被计数、再被定日期的间隔。

intro.en: The -ennial family counts years: annual, biennial, triennial, quadrennial, perennial.
intro.cn: -ennial 词族在数年：annual、biennial、triennial、quadrennial、perennial。

latinIntro.en: Latin annus gives the year; quadri- gives the four; -ial makes the adjective. The noun quadrennium keeps the same pieces.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 annus 给出「年」，quadri- 给出「四」，-ial 造形容词。名词 quadrennium 保留同样的部件。

definition_zh: 正直；操守端正；（判断的）正确
definition_en: moral uprightness, or the quality of being correct in judgment
core_image: 一条拉得笔直的墨线，从纸的一端一直画到另一端，中间没有弯
scene: 他一辈子没有收过一笔不该收的钱，连对手也承认这一点。 Even his rivals spoke of the old judge's rectitude.
sceneCN: 这里 rectitude 指正直、操守端正（第 1 个义项：道德上的端正）；句意为连对手也承认这位老法官的正直。

derivatives.zh: 道德端正的；一本正经的

senses.title: Moral rectitude
senses.definition: the quality of being morally upright and honest
senses.definitionCN: 在道德上端正、诚实无欺的品质
senses.example: Even his rivals spoke of the old judge's rectitude.
senses.exampleCN: 连对手也承认这位老法官的正直。
senses.why: The first sense is about character: the line inside a person does not bend.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项讲的是品格：人心里那条线不弯。

senses.title: Rectitude of judgment
senses.definition: the quality of being correct or exact in judgement or method
senses.definitionCN: 在判断或方法上正确、准确的品质
senses.example: The essay was praised for the rectitude of its judgment.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇文章因判断的准确而受到称赞。
senses.why: Here the straightness is intellectual, not moral.
senses.whyCN: 这里的「直」是智性的，而不是道德的。

intro.en: Rectitude comes from Latin rectitudo, 'straightness', from rectus, 'straight or right'.
intro.cn: rectitude 来自拉丁语 rectitudo（笔直），源于 rectus（直、正）。

items.en: Rectus meant straight or right.
items.cn: rectus 意为直的、正的。

items.en: Rectitudo named the quality of being straight.
items.cn: rectitudo 指「直」这一性质。

items.en: A straight line became an image of an honest life.
items.cn: 一条直线成了诚实生活的意象。

items.en: English took the word for uprightness of character.
items.cn: 英语用它指品格的端正。

items.en: Today it is formal and slightly old-fashioned.
items.cn: 今天它正式而略带古意。

note.en: The look-alike group is the rect- family; the near-meaning group separates integrity, uprightness, probity and honesty.
note.cn: 形近组是 rect 词族；近义组把「完整人格」「端正」「廉洁」「诚实」分开。

entries.definition: to correct or make straight.
entries.definitionCN: 纠正；弄直。

entries.definition: formed by straight lines.
entries.definitionCN: 由直线构成的。

entries.definition: shaped with right angles.
entries.definitionCN: 带直角的形状。

entries.definition: a four-sided right-angled figure.
entries.definitionCN: 四个直角的四边形。

entries.definition: wholeness of character that resists corruption.
entries.definitionCN: 不为腐蚀所动的人格完整。

entries.definition: the state of being morally straight.
entries.definitionCN: 道德上端正的状态。

entries.definition: tested honesty in public life.
entries.definitionCN: 公共生活中经得起考验的诚实。

entries.definition: truthfulness and fair dealing.
entries.definitionCN: 诚实与公平。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a ruled line drawn from edge to edge without a bend.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一条从纸边拉到纸边、中间不弯的墨线」的画面。

normal.en: Rectitude is the noun of rectus, straightness itself.
normal.cn: rectitude 是 rectus 的名词形式，就是「直」本身。

normal.en: Picture the ruler laid down and the line following it exactly.
normal.cn: 想象尺子压住纸，线完全贴着它走。

normal.en: Say REK-tih-tyood; the last syllable is long.
normal.cn: 读 REK-tih-tyood，最后一个音节是长音。

normal.en: The word prefers courts, biographies and obituaries.
normal.cn: 这个词偏爱法庭、传记与讣告。

normal.en: Ask where the line would bend if no one were watching.
normal.cn: 问如果没人看着，这条线会在哪里弯。

abstract.en: Rectitude is a straight line that has learned to feel shame.
abstract.cn: 正直是一条学会了羞耻的直线。

abstract.en: Character is geometry that keeps its shape under pressure.
abstract.cn: 品格是在压力下仍保持形状的几何。

abstract.en: The word is old because the virtue is older than the word.
abstract.cn: 这个词老，因为这种德性比词更老。

examples.en: Even his rivals spoke of the old judge's rectitude.
examples.cn: 连对手也承认这位老法官的正直。

examples.en: The essay was praised for the rectitude of its judgment.
examples.cn: 这篇文章因判断的准确而受到称赞。

examples.en: She was known for a rectitude that made flattery useless.
examples.cn: 她以正直著称，奉承对她毫无用处。

dict_mnemonic.text: rect（直）+ itude（性质）→ 一条不弯的直线，用作人的品格。

root: 拉丁语 rectitudo（笔直）→ rectus（直、正）

sensesIntro.en: Two senses keep the same straight line: one in a person's character, one in a person's judgement.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项守着同一条直线：一条在人的品格里，一条在人的判断里。

core.en: A LINE THAT DOES NOT BEND
core.cn: 不弯的那条线

branches.en: The moral line held inside a person.
branches.cn: 守在人心里那条道德的线。

branches.en: The intellectual line held in judgement.
branches.cn: 守判断里那条智性的线。

branches.en: Both are straightness, one of will and one of mind.
branches.cn: 两者都是直，一个是意志的，一个是心智的。

branches.en: Character is what the neighbours cannot see.
branches.cn: 品格是邻居看不见的东西。

branches.en: Judgement is what the reader can check.
branches.cn: 判断是读者可以核对的东西。

intro.en: The rect- family is about straightness: rectitude, rectify and rectilinear all stand on the same Latin line.
intro.cn: rect 词族讲的是「直」：rectitude、rectify、rectilinear 都立在同一根拉丁线上。

latinIntro.en: Latin rectus, 'straight', gives rectitudo, 'straightness'; English turned the physical line into a word about character.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 rectus（直）给出 rectitudo（笔直）；英语把这条实体的线变成了说品格的词。

items.exampleCN: 一个直线式的街道规划。

definition_zh: 多维的；多方面的；多元的；多维度的
definition_en: existing in or involving several dimensions, or having many different aspects rather than a single one
core_image: 一个立方体里再叠着几个方向，每个方向都能单独拉出一条刻度
scene: 投影幕上出现一个立方体，三个方向都标着刻度，旁边还叠着几张不同层面的数据表。 The study treats poverty as a multidimensional problem rather than a single income figure.
sceneCN: 这里 multidimensional 指「包含许多方面、不能化成一个指标」（第 2 个义项：多方面的）；句意：这项研究把贫困当作一个多维度的问题，而不是单一收入数字。图中可辨识物件：投影幕、立方体、三条刻度轴、分层数据表。

pos.zh: 多维的；多方面的；多元的

derivatives.zh: 多维分析（数据分析方法）

senses.title: Having several spatial dimensions
senses.definition: described by more than three coordinates, as a mathematical or physical space can be
senses.definitionCN: 用三个以上坐标来描述，数学或物理空间可以如此
senses.example: The dataset lives in a multidimensional space of ten coordinates.
senses.exampleCN: 这个数据集处在一个十坐标的多维空间里。
senses.why: Multi- 'many' plus dimension: space itself can be given more axes than the three of ordinary experience.
senses.whyCN: multi-「多」加 dimension：空间可以比日常经验的三维多出更多轴。

senses.title: Having many aspects
senses.definition: involving several distinct factors or sides that cannot be reduced to one measure
senses.definitionCN: 涉及几个不同因素或侧面，不能简化成一个指标
senses.example: Housing is a multidimensional issue of cost, safety and location.
senses.exampleCN: 住房是涉及成本、安全与位置的多方面问题。
senses.why: A single number is one dimension; when a problem needs several numbers at once, it becomes multidimensional.
senses.whyCN: 一个数字就是一维；一个问题需要同时用几个数字衡量，就变成多维的。

senses.title: An array with several indices
senses.definition: a data structure whose elements are addressed by two or more indices, such as a table or a cube
senses.definitionCN: 元素由两个或更多下标定位的数据结构，如表格或数据立方
senses.example: The image is stored as a multidimensional array of pixel values.
senses.exampleCN: 图像被存成一个由像素值构成的多维数组。
senses.why: Each index adds an axis, so a table of tables is literally an array with more than one dimension.
senses.whyCN: 每增加一个下标就多一条轴，因此「表格的表格」字面上就是多维数组。

senses.title: Mapping distances into fewer axes
senses.titleCN: 把距离压缩到较少坐标上
senses.definition: a statistical technique that places objects in a low-dimensional map while preserving their measured distances
senses.definitionCN: 把对象放到低维图上、同时尽量保留其测得距离的统计方法
senses.example: Multidimensional scaling turned the survey distances into a two-axis map.
senses.exampleCN: 多维标度法把调查得到的距离转成一张两轴图。
senses.why: The method takes many measured dimensions and squeezes them into a few axes that can be drawn.
senses.whyCN: 这种方法把许多测得的维度压缩成几条可以画出来的轴。

senses.title: Analysis across several attributes
senses.definition: querying and summarising data by several attributes at once, as in a data warehouse cube
senses.definitionCN: 同时按多个属性查询与汇总数据，如数据仓库中的立方体
senses.example: The sales team ran a multidimensional analysis by region and quarter.
senses.exampleCN: 销售团队按地区与季度做了一次多维分析。
senses.why: Each attribute is an axis of the cube, so slicing by two attributes is a multidimensional operation.
senses.whyCN: 每个属性都是立方体的一条轴，按两个属性切分就是多维操作。

senses.title: A person with many sides
senses.definition: having a rich and varied character, identity or talent rather than a single flat trait
senses.definitionCN: 性格、身份或才能丰富多样，而不是单一扁平的特质
senses.example: The portrait presents a multidimensional character, not a hero or a villain.
senses.exampleCN: 这幅人物画像呈现一个有多个侧面的人物，而非简单的英雄或恶人。
senses.why: Describing a person in more than one dimension is the same metaphor as describing a space with more than one axis.
senses.whyCN: 用不止一个维度来描述人，与用不止一条轴描述空间，是同一个比喻。

senses.title: Poverty measured on several scales
senses.titleCN: 用多个尺度衡量的贫困
senses.definition: an index that counts deprivations in health, education and living standards together rather than income alone
senses.definitionCN: 把健康、教育与生活水平方面的匮乏合并计算，而非只看收入的指数
senses.example: The multidimensional poverty index counts several deprivations at once.
senses.exampleCN: 多维贫困指数同时计算多项匮乏。
senses.why: Poverty has more than one face, so the measure adds axes instead of collapsing everything into income.
senses.whyCN: 贫困不止一副面孔，因此这种测量增加坐标轴，而不是把所有东西压成收入一项。

senses.title: Extra dimensions in modern physics
senses.titleCN: 现代物理中的额外维度
senses.definition: describing theories in which space has more than the three familiar dimensions, often compactified and unseen
senses.definitionCN: 描述空间多于熟悉的三维、额外维度常被紧致化而不可见的理论
senses.example: String theory requires a multidimensional universe with hidden extra dimensions.
senses.exampleCN: 弦理论需要一个带隐藏额外维度的多维宇宙。
senses.why: Physics extends the geometric meaning to dimensions that exist mathematically even when they cannot be seen.
senses.whyCN: 物理把几何义扩展到那些数学上存在、却看不见的维度。

intro.en: Multidimensional is an English compound of multi- 'many', from Latin multus, and dimension, from Latin dimensio 'a measuring', built on dimetiri 'to measure out'. The compound itself is modern English. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: multidimensional 是英语复合词，由 multi-「多」（出自拉丁 multus）与 dimension（出自拉丁 dimensio「测量」，由 dimetiri「量出」构成）组成。复合词本身属现代英语。年代均为约数。

items.en: Multus meant 'much, many', and it gives English multi-, multitude and multiply; it supplies the 'many' of the compound.
items.cn: multus 意为「多、许多」，衍生英语 multi-、multitude 与 multiply；它为复合词提供了「多」这一部分。

items.en: Metiri meant 'to measure', and it also gives meter and measure; measuring is the older core of dimension.
items.cn: metiri 意为「测量」，也衍生 meter 与 measure；测量是 dimension 更古老的核心。

items.en: Dimensio was 'a measuring out'; English dimension first meant a measurement and later a direction in which a body extends.
items.cn: dimensio 意为「量出」；英语 dimension 先指测量，后指物体延伸的一个方向。

items.en: English joined multi- and dimensional to describe spaces, data and problems that need more than one axis.
items.cn: 英语把 multi- 与 dimensional 拼在一起，描述需要不止一条轴的空间、数据与问题。

items.en: Multidimensional scaling, multidimensional arrays and multidimensional analysis each fixed a technical sense in the twentieth century.
items.cn: 多维标度法、多维数组与多维分析都在二十世纪固定了各自的技术含义。

items.en: First English citation uncertain: the word is a transparent English compound of multi- and dimensional, so its formation is not in doubt; only the earliest recorded English use is undated. The deeper origin of multus is not established, and no reconstructed root is asserted.
items.cn: 首见年代不确定：这个词是 multi- 与 dimensional 构成的透明英语复合词，构词方式并不存疑；只是英语最早用例没有确切年代。multus 的更早来源无定论，此处不给出重构词根。

note.en: Group one shares the dimension stock, where a suffix or prefix changes how many axes are being counted; group two holds words for many-sided things that are not strictly geometric.
note.cn: 第一组共享 dimension 词干，前后缀改变的是「数几条轴」；第二组是形容多面事物、但不严格属于几何的词。

entries.definition: A single measurable direction or aspect; multidimensional simply multiplies it.
entries.definitionCN: 一条可测量的方向或一个方面；multidimensional 只是把它变成多条。

entries.definition: Relating to dimensions; multi- attaches to this adjective to make the compound.
entries.definitionCN: 与维度有关的；multi- 加在这个形容词上构成复合词。

entries.definition: The state of having several dimensions; the abstract noun built from the adjective.
entries.definitionCN: 具有多个维度的状态；由该形容词构成的名词。

entries.definition: Measured or understood along a single axis; the direct opposite of multidimensional.
entries.definitionCN: 只沿一条轴测量或理解；与 multidimensional 直接相对。

entries.definition: Having many sides or aspects, often of a person or a problem; the picture is a cut gem, not a coordinate space.
entries.definitionCN: 有许多侧面或方面，常用于人或问题；意象是切面宝石，而非坐标空间。

entries.definition: Involving several measured variables; a statistical term close to multidimensional analysis.
entries.definitionCN: 涉及多个被测变量；接近多维分析的统计术语。

entries.definition: Having many aspects; the everyday phrase with no technical definition.
entries.definitionCN: 有许多方面；没有技术定义的日常说法。

entries.definition: Made of many connected parts; it stresses difficulty of understanding rather than number of axes.
entries.definitionCN: 由许多相互关联的部分组成；强调理解的难度，而非轴的数目。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: Latin 'many' plus Latin 'measure', the array with several indices and the real statistical uses.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：拉丁「多」加拉丁「测量」、带多个下标的数组，以及真实的统计用法。

normal.en: Multi- 'many' plus dimension: more than one axis.
normal.cn: multi-「多」加 dimension：不止一条轴。

normal.en: A table has two indices, so it is already multidimensional.
normal.cn: 一张表有两个下标，本身就已经是多维的。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: multidimensional array, multidimensional scaling, multidimensional analysis.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：多维数组、多维标度法、多维分析。

normal.en: The opposite is unidimensional, built with the prefix meaning one.
normal.cn: 反义是 unidimensional，用表示「一」的前缀构成。

normal.en: Development studies count several deprivations together as multidimensional poverty.
normal.cn: 发展研究把多项匮乏合并计算，称为多维贫困。

abstract.en: Picture a cube with a second set of axes growing out of each corner.
abstract.cn: 想象一个立方体的每个角上又长出一组新的轴。

abstract.en: Picture a problem that cannot be written on one line of a form.
abstract.cn: 想象一个问题没法填进表格的一行里。

abstract.en: Picture a portrait painted from several directions at once.
abstract.cn: 想象一幅同时从几个方向画成的人像。

examples.en: The sensor produces a multidimensional signal that must be reduced before plotting.
examples.cn: 传感器产生多维信号，绘图前必须先降维。

examples.en: A multidimensional approach to health considers diet, housing and income together.
examples.cn: 对健康的多维研究把饮食、住房与收入放在一起考虑。

examples.en: The team used multidimensional scaling to place the samples on a simple map.
examples.cn: 团队用多维标度法把样本放到一张简单的地图上。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「multi（多）+ dimensional（维度的）」——有很多个维度：多维的、多方面的

root: 英语复合词：multi-（拉丁 multus「多」）+ dimensional（dimension 出自拉丁 dimensio「测量」，源于 dimetiri「量出」）。复合本身是英语构词。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses add axes one by one: a many-coordinate space, a problem with many aspects, an array with several indices, a distance map, analysis across attributes, a many-sided person, a poverty index and unseen dimensions in physics.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项一条条加上轴：多坐标空间、包含多方面的问题、带多个下标的数组、距离映射、跨属性分析、有多个侧面的人、贫困指数，以及物理中看不见的维度。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one more axis added to the familiar three, so that no single number can describe the whole.
core.cn: 核心意象：在熟悉的三维之外再加一条轴，于是没有任何一个数字能描述整体。

branches.en: GEOMETRIC AXES: an ordinary many-coordinate space and the hidden dimensions of physics are the same geometry at different scales of belief.
branches.cn: 几何的轴：寻常的多坐标空间与物理中隐藏的维度，是同一几何在不同可信尺度上的样子。

branches.en: MANY SIDES: a problem and a person both resist being reduced to one measurement.
branches.cn: 多个侧面：一个问题与一个人，都不肯被压成一个测量值。

branches.en: DATA CUBES: an array with several indices and an analysis across attributes are the storage and the query of the same cube.
branches.cn: 数据立方：带多个下标的数组与跨属性分析，是同一个立方体的存储面与查询面。

branches.en: THE DISTANCE MAP: scaling squeezes many measured axes into a few that can be drawn.
branches.cn: 距离地图：标度法把许多测得的轴压成少数几条可以画出来的轴。

branches.en: COUNTING DEPRIVATIONS: poverty is measured on several scales because one scale hides the rest.
branches.cn: 清点匮乏：贫困要用多个尺度衡量，因为单一尺度会把其余的都遮住。

intro.en: Multidimensional combines a Latin quantity prefix with an English adjective that Latin built from a measuring verb.
intro.cn: multidimensional 把拉丁数量前缀与一个英语形容词组合起来，而那个形容词由拉丁测量动词构成。

latinIntro.en: Multus 'many' gives multi- and multiply; metiri 'to measure' gives meter, measure and dimensio; -alis survives as -al in dimensional.
latinIntro.cn: multus「多」衍生 multi- 与 multiply；metiri「测量」衍生 meter、measure 与 dimensio；-alis 在 dimensional 中留下 -al。

items.example: Multi- turns a single-axis adjective into a many-axis one.
items.exampleCN: multi- 把单轴形容词变成多轴形容词。

items.example: The Latin adjective is the source of the prefix.
items.exampleCN: 这个拉丁形容词是前缀的来源。

items.example: The verb supplies the measuring inside dimension.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词提供 dimension 内部的「测量」义。

items.example: The Latin noun became English dimension.
items.exampleCN: 这个拉丁名词变成英语 dimension。

items.example: A line has one dimension and a cube has three.
items.exampleCN: 线有一维，立方体有三元。

items.example: The table stores a multidimensional array.
items.exampleCN: 这张表存着一个多维数组。

items.example: The study stressed the multidimensionality of poverty.
items.exampleCN: 这项研究强调贫困的多维性。

items.example: A single score gives a unidimensional view.
items.exampleCN: 单一分数给出的是单维视角。

sceneCN: 这里 antiseptic 是「消毒剂」（第 2 个义项：用来杀菌防腐的物质）；句意为护士用消毒剂擦拭伤口。

senses.title: Preventing infection
senses.definition: describing substances or conditions that stop germs from growing and wounds from festering
senses.definitionCN: 指能阻止病菌繁殖、防止伤口化脓的物质或环境
senses.example: Antiseptic surgery dramatically cut deaths after operations.
senses.exampleCN: 无菌外科手术大幅降低了术后死亡率。
senses.why: Anti- means 'against' and septikos 'putrefying', so the word literally means 'against rot'.
senses.whyCN: anti- 表示「对抗」，septikos 意为「腐烂的」，字面即「对抗腐坏」。

senses.title: A germ-killing substance
senses.definition: a chemical applied to skin or wounds to kill or slow the growth of germs
senses.definitionCN: 涂敷于皮肤或伤口以杀灭或抑制病菌的化学制剂
senses.example: The nurse wiped the wound with antiseptic.
senses.exampleCN: 护士用消毒剂擦拭伤口。
senses.why: A word that names a quality easily names the thing carrying the quality.
senses.whyCN: 表示性质的词很容易转指带有该性质的东西。

senses.title: Coldly clean and impersonal
senses.titleCN: 冷漠超然的；无菌般洁净的
senses.definition: describing places or manners that are spotless yet strangely lifeless and unemotional
senses.definitionCN: 形容一尘不染却缺乏生气与情感的地方或态度
senses.example: The hotel lobby felt antiseptic, with no trace of anyone at home.
senses.exampleCN: 酒店大堂洁净得冷漠，没有一点生活的痕迹。
senses.why: The hospital's sterile cleanliness became the picture of any place scrubbed of feeling.
senses.whyCN: 医院无菌般的洁净，被引申为任何被擦去人情的场所的样子。

intro.en: Antiseptic pairs Greek anti 'against' with septikos 'putrefying', coined in the age of germ theory.
intro.cn: antiseptic 由希腊语 anti「对抗」与 septikos「腐烂的」组合而成，诞生于细菌理论时代。

items.en: The root *sehp- meant 'to rot, decay', giving Greek sepein 'to putrefy'.
items.cn: 词根 *sehp- 意为「腐烂」，衍生出希腊语 sepein「使腐败」。

items.en: anti meant 'against', and septikos meant 'causing putrefaction'.
items.cn: 希腊语 anti 意为「对抗」，septikos 意为「导致腐烂的」。

items.en: The English word was formed in the mid-eighteenth century from these Greek parts.
items.cn: 英语于十八世纪中叶用这两个希腊语成分构成此词。

items.en: Joseph Lister's antiseptic surgery turned the word into a milestone of medicine.
items.cn: 李斯特的抗菌外科手术使这个词成为医学里程碑。

items.en: Today the word covers real germ-killers and, by metaphor, any airless kind of cleanliness.
items.cn: 如今这个词既指真正的杀菌剂，也隐喻毫无生气的洁净。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the sepsis family and anti- words; the near-meaning group collects germ-fighters.
note.cn: 形近组收 sepsis 词族与 anti- 词；近义组收集各种杀菌之物。

entries.definition: infected with putrefying germs
entries.definitionCN: 感染的；脓毒的，与本词同根且意义相反

entries.definition: a medicine that kills bacteria inside the body
entries.definitionCN: 抗生素，同样以 anti- 开头但作用于体内

entries.definition: free from germs, as in aseptic packaging
entries.definitionCN: 无菌的，词形相近，来自不同的否定前缀 a-

entries.definition: a chemical that cleans surfaces of germs
entries.definitionCN: 消毒液，多用于物体表面而非伤口

entries.definition: an agent that kills germs
entries.definitionCN: 杀菌剂

entries.definition: completely free from living germs
entries.definitionCN: 无菌的；消过毒的

normal.en: Antiseptic acts on the skin; antibiotic acts inside the body.

abstract.en: See an empty marble corridor with no people at all.
