definition_zh: v. 使脱水；使干燥；（身体）失去水分
definition_en: to remove water from something, or to lose too much water from the body

scene: 长途飞行让他严重缺水。 The long flight dehydrated him badly.

senses.title: Remove water from food

senses.exampleCN: 他们在包装前把水果脱水。
senses.why: Slices shrinking on a warm drying rack.
senses.whyCN: 暖烘干架上正在缩小的薄片。

senses.title: Dry out a surface

senses.exampleCN: 暖气使房间里的空气变干。

senses.whyCN: 干裂的嘴唇挨着一台干燥的暖气片。

items.en: Hydōr meant water in Greek.
items.cn: 希腊语 hydōr 意为水。

items.en: Hydrate named a compound holding water.
items.cn: hydrate 指含水的化合物。

items.en: Dehydrate was formed for removing that water.

items.en: Doctors used it for patients losing fluid.

items.en: Dried milk and vegetables put it on labels.

definition_zh: 地理分布；地理分布格局
definition_en: the way a species, population, language, resource, or other phenomenon is spread across the surface of the earth
core_image: 一张世界地图上用不同深浅标出的物种分布斑块
scene: 研究者把这种候鸟的繁殖地、迁徙路线与越冬地叠加到一张地图上，得到它的地理分布图。 Researchers overlaid the bird's breeding grounds, migration routes, and wintering sites on one map to obtain its geographic distribution.
sceneCN: 这里 geographic distribution 是「地理分布」（第 1 个义项：物种在地表占据的范围）；句意：研究者把这种候鸟的繁殖地、迁徙路线与越冬地叠加到一张地图上，得到它的地理分布。

pos.zh: 地理分布；地理分布格局（可数，复数为 geographic distributions）

senses.title: Range occupied by a species
senses.definition: the area over which a species or population is naturally found
senses.definitionCN: 某一物种或种群自然出现的地域范围
senses.example: The geographic distribution of the orchid stops at the first frost line.
senses.exampleCN: 这种兰花的地理分布到第一条霜线为止。
senses.why: Geo- means earth and distribution means being allotted out. Together they name the map-shaped answer to the question 'where does this organism occur?'
senses.whyCN: geo- 意为“地球”，distribution 意为“被分配开”。合起来就是“这种生物出现在哪里”这一问题的地图式答案。

senses.title: Pattern rather than mere range
senses.titleCN: 分布格局而非仅有范围
senses.definition: the spatial pattern in which members of a group are arranged, including gaps, clusters, and borders
senses.definitionCN: 群体成员在空间中的排列方式，包括空白、聚集与边界
senses.example: The species shows a patchy geographic distribution along the coast.
senses.exampleCN: 该物种沿海岸呈斑块状地理分布。
senses.why: Distribution adds the idea of allotment to space: not only where the border lies, but how presence is divided into patches, corridors, and empty zones.
senses.whyCN: distribution 把“分配”带入空间：不只是边界在哪里，还包括“有”如何被分成斑块、走廊与空白区。

senses.title: Distribution of a human population
senses.definition: the arrangement of human populations across regions, often measured by density
senses.definitionCN: 人口在各区域的排列，常用密度衡量
senses.example: The country's geographic distribution of population is dominated by two coastal belts.
senses.exampleCN: 该国人口的地理分布以两条沿海带为主。
senses.why: Here the items distributed are people. The phrase keeps the map frame but the variable is density, so the same term serves demography as well as ecology.
senses.whyCN: 这里被分布的对象是人。短语保持地图框架，但变量是密度，因此同一术语既服务人口学也服务生态学。

senses.title: Distribution of resources
senses.definition: the way minerals, water, fertile land, or energy sources are located across a territory
senses.definitionCN: 矿产、水、肥沃土地或能源在一国领土上的位置分布
senses.example: The geographic distribution of lithium shapes national energy policy.
senses.exampleCN: 锂矿的地理分布塑造了国家能源政策。
senses.why: Resources are 'allotted' by geology rather than by choice, so the phrase describes an uneven map that people must adapt to rather than design.
senses.whyCN: 资源是由地质而非人力“分配”的，因此该短语描述一张人必须适应、而非能够设计的不均衡地图。

senses.title: Distribution of a disease
senses.definition: the pattern of where cases of a disease occur, often used to find environmental causes
senses.definitionCN: 疾病病例出现地点的格局，常用于寻找环境成因
senses.example: The geographic distribution of the fever pointed to a mosquito-borne cause.
senses.exampleCN: 这种热病的地理分布指向蚊媒病因。
senses.why: Epidemiology borrows the map: cases are plotted as points, and the shape of their scatter becomes evidence about transmission and environment.
senses.whyCN: 流行病学借用了这张地图：病例被标为点，其散布形状成为关于传播与环境的证据。

senses.title: Distribution of languages or cultures
senses.titleCN: 语言或文化的地理分布
senses.definition: the areas in which a language, dialect, or cultural practice is used
senses.definitionCN: 某种语言、方言或文化习俗被使用的区域
senses.example: The geographic distribution of the dialect follows old river trade routes.
senses.exampleCN: 该方言的地理分布沿古老的河流贸易路线展开。
senses.why: Language is treated as a population with a range; its 'distribution' is the map of speakers, and borders often reflect historical movement rather than nature.
senses.whyCN: 语言被当作具有分布范围的种群；其“分布”是使用者的地图，边界往往反映历史迁移而非自然界线。

senses.title: The mapped result itself
senses.definition: a map or dataset that shows where something occurs, used as a research product
senses.definitionCN: 显示某事物出现位置的地图或数据集，作为研究成果
senses.example: The atlas contains a geographic distribution for each of the 300 species.
senses.exampleCN: 这本图集为 300 个物种各提供一幅地理分布图。
senses.why: By metonymy the phrase shifts from the fact to its representation: the distribution is what the dots on the map show, not the landscape itself.
senses.whyCN: 通过转喻，短语从事实转向其再现：所谓 distribution 就是地图上的点所显示的内容，而不是景观本身。

senses.title: The study of spatial ranges
senses.titleCN: 对空间分布的研究领域
senses.definition: the subfield or analytical question concerned with where organisms or phenomena occur and why
senses.definitionCN: 关注生物或现象出现在何处及其原因的子领域或分析问题
senses.example: Biogeography treats geographic distribution as its central problem.
senses.exampleCN: 生物地理学把地理分布作为核心问题。
senses.why: When used as a topic name, the phrase names a question rather than an object: the research agenda of explaining why ranges have the shapes they do.
senses.whyCN: 作为课题名称时，该短语指一个问题而非一个对象：解释分布范围为何呈现这些形状的研究议程。

intro.en: The phrase is a modern compound of Greek geo- 'earth', Greek -graphia 'writing', and Latin distribuere 'to allot'. It is not an inherited unit but an English scientific coinage.
intro.cn: 这个短语是希腊语 geo-「大地」、希腊语 -graphia「书写」与拉丁语 distribuere「分配」组合成的现代词组；它不是承继而来的单位，而是英语科学造词。

items.en: geō- comes from gē 'earth, land'; the related geōdēs meant 'earthlike'. English uses geo- freely in scientific compounds.
items.cn: geō- 来自 gē「大地、土地」；相关的 geōdēs 意为“像大地的”。英语在科学复合词中自由使用 geo-。

items.en: -graphic comes from graphein 'to write, draw', so geographic is 'earth-writing' — the drawing of the earth on a surface.
items.cn: -graphic 来自 graphein「写、画」，因此 geographic 就是“书写大地”——把大地画在平面上。

items.en: distribution comes from distribuere 'to deal out, allot', from dis- 'apart' + tribuere 'to assign, allot'. The noun distributio is the act of dividing out.
items.cn: distribution 来自 distribuere「分发、分配」，由 dis-「分开」+ tribuere「指派、分配」构成；名词 distributio 指分派的行为。

items.en: Geographic entered English in the 17th century; distribution was already an English noun. The collocation became standard with the growth of biogeography in the 19th century.
items.cn: geographic 于 17 世纪进入英语，distribution 当时已是英语名词；随着 19 世纪生物地理学的发展，这一搭配成为标准术语。

items.en: Modern usage prefers geographic in American English and geographical in British English; both patterns appear in academic writing, and the phrase behaves as a countable noun.
items.cn: 现代用法中，美式英语多用 geographic，英式英语多用 geographical；两种形式都见于学术写作，该短语作可数名词使用。

note.en: The first group separates terms that look alike, the second compares related spatial terms.
note.cn: 第一组区分形近术语，第二组比较相关的空间术语。

entries.definition: the British-preferred variant of the same phrase; the meaning is identical.
entries.definitionCN: 同一短语的英式优先拼写变体，意义完全相同。

entries.definition: the arrangement of rocks or strata, not of organisms; geo- is shared but -logic differs.
entries.definitionCN: 岩石或地层的排列，而非生物的分布；共享 geo- 但 -logic 不同。

entries.definition: distribution in space at any scale, including indoors or in a cell; geographic specifies the earth's surface.
entries.definitionCN: 任何尺度上的空间分布，包括室内或细胞内；geographic 特指地表。

entries.definition: the arrangement of people or organisms, one common type of geographic distribution.
entries.definitionCN: 人或生物的排列，是地理分布的一种常见类型。

entries.definition: the area within which a species occurs. It names the outer limit, while distribution includes internal pattern.
entries.definitionCN: 物种出现的区域。它指外围界线，而 distribution 还包括内部格局。

entries.definition: the kind of place an organism lives in, not where that kind of place lies on the map.
entries.definitionCN: 生物栖居的场所类型，而不是这类场所在图上的位置。

entries.definition: the study of the geographic distribution of organisms; the phrase names its object, the discipline names the field.
entries.definitionCN: 研究生物地理分布的学科；短语指其对象，学科名指该领域。

entries.definition: the movement that produces a distribution; the result is the map, the process is the spread.
entries.definitionCN: 产生分布的移动过程；结果是地图，过程是 spread。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real Greek and Latin parts, plus standard collocations from ecology and demography.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的希腊语与拉丁语成分，加上生态学与人口学的标准搭配。

normal.en: geo- = earth, -graphic = drawing: geographic is 'drawing the earth'.
normal.cn: geo- = 大地，-graphic = 绘制：geographic 就是“绘制大地”。

normal.en: distribution from distribuere 'allot apart' supplies the 'how it is divided' half of the phrase.
normal.cn: distribution 来自 distribuere「分开分配」，提供短语中“如何被分割”的那一半。

normal.en: Biogeography is the discipline that studies geographic distribution; the map is the object, the field is the study.
normal.cn: biogeography 是研究地理分布的学科；地图是对象，学科名是研究领域。

normal.en: Range is the outer limit, distribution is the whole pattern of patches and gaps.
normal.cn: range 是外围界线，distribution 是斑块与空白构成的整体格局。

normal.en: Population distribution, disease distribution, and resource distribution all reuse the same map frame.
normal.cn: 人口分布、疾病分布、资源分布都复用同一张地图框架。

abstract.en: Imagine a sheet of paper with pins: the pins are occurrences, their clustering is the pattern, and the paper is the earth's surface.
abstract.cn: 想象一张插满图钉的纸：图钉是出现点，它们的聚散是格局，纸就是地表。

abstract.en: The phrase is a marriage of two gestures: drawing the earth, and dividing something out across it.
abstract.cn: 这个短语是两种动作的结合：把大地画出来，以及把某物分派到大地各处。

abstract.en: A distribution answers 'where' and 'how evenly'; a range answers only 'how far'.
abstract.cn: 分布回答“在哪里”和“是否均匀”；范围只回答“到多远”。

examples.en: Climate change is shifting the geographic distribution of many tree species.
examples.cn: 气候变化正在改变许多树种的地理分布。

examples.en: The report mapped the geographic distribution of untreated wells across the province.
examples.cn: 报告绘制了全省未处理水井的地理分布。

examples.en: Its broad geographic distribution suggests the frog tolerates a wide range of temperatures.
examples.cn: 其广泛的地理分布表明这种蛙能耐受很大的温度范围。

dict_mnemonic.text: “几何分布”——把地图摊开，用几何格子把物种分布画出来 → geographic distribution 地理分布

root: 希腊语 gē（大地）+ graphein（书写）构成 geographic；distribution 来自拉丁语 distribuere（分配、分派）。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of the phrase: a species range, a spatial pattern, and then the same map frame applied to people, resources, disease, languages, the map as a product, and the study of ranges.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个短语的八个义项：先是物种范围与空间格局，再把同一地图框架用于人口、资源、疾病、语言，直到作为成果的分布图与对分布范围的研究。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a world map with shaded patches showing where something occurs.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张世界地图，用不同深浅的斑块显示某物出现的位置。

branches.en: SPECIES: the range itself and the internal pattern of patches and gaps.
branches.cn: 物种：分布范围本身，以及斑块与空白的内部格局。

branches.en: VARIABLES: the same frame carries people, resources, and disease cases.
branches.cn: 变量：同一框架承载人口、资源与疾病病例。

branches.en: CULTURE: languages and practices occupy areas shaped by history.
branches.cn: 文化：语言与习俗占据由历史塑造的区域。

branches.en: PRODUCT: the map or dataset becomes the distribution itself by metonymy.
branches.cn: 成果：地图或数据集通过转喻成为“分布”本身。

branches.en: DISCIPLINE: the phrase names a research question about why ranges have their shapes.
branches.cn: 学科：短语指“分布范围为何呈现这些形状”的研究问题。

intro.en: The phrase combines a Greek scientific prefix geo-, the Greek combining form -graphic, and the Latin noun distribution. Only geo- and -graphic are productive English elements.
intro.cn: 该短语由希腊语科学前缀 geo-、希腊语组合形式 -graphic 与拉丁语名词 distribution 组合；其中只有 geo- 与 -graphic 是英语中能产的成分。

latinIntro.en: Latin distribuere 'to allot' yields distribute, distribution, distributive, and distributor; Greek gē yields geography, geology, geometry, and geocentric.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 distribuere「分配」衍生 distribute、distribution、distributive、distributor；希腊语 gē 衍生 geography、geology、geometry、geocentric。

items.meaning: the writing or description of the earth
items.meaningCN: 地理学；对地球的书写与描述

items.example: Geographic data are stored as coordinates.
items.exampleCN: 地理数据以坐标形式存储。

items.meaningCN: 英式优先的形容词形式
items.example: The geographical society funded the survey.
items.exampleCN: 地理学会资助了这次调查。

items.meaningCN: 分派的行为（dis- 分开 + tribuere 分配 + -ion 名词）
items.example: The distribution of rainfall is uneven.
The species is distributed along the coast.
A distributive map shows each region.

items.exampleCN: 早期模型以地心为中心。

items.meaning: the study of life's geographic patterns
items.meaningCN: 研究生物地理格局的学科
items.exampleCN: 生物地理学解释岛屿物种。

definition_zh: 掺杂物；掺假用的物质
definition_en: a substance added to something to make it impure or of lower quality
core_image: 一勺白粉悄悄混进整袋奶粉里，袋子没变重多少，东西却坏了
scene: 化验员把样本放进仪器，屏幕上跳出一条多余的曲线。 The lab found an adulterant mixed into the chili powder.
sceneCN: 这里 adulterant 是「掺杂物」（第 1 个义项：被故意混进去以降低纯度的物质）；句意为实验室在辣椒粉里检出了掺杂物。

derivatives.zh: 动词基础形式，义为「掺假；使不纯」
由动词加名词后缀构成，义为「掺假行为；掺杂」
由动词过去分词转形容词，义为「掺了假的」

senses.title: Substance that spoils purity
senses.definition: a foreign substance mixed into a food, drug or material to make it cheaper or heavier
senses.definitionCN: 混进食品、药品或原料中使其变便宜或变重的外来物质
senses.example: Water is the cheapest adulterant in milk.
senses.exampleCN: 水是牛奶里最便宜的掺杂物。
senses.why: Latin adulterare means 'to pollute', so an adulterant is literally a polluting ingredient.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 adulterare 意为「污染」，所以 adulterant 字面上就是污染性成分。

senses.title: Describing such a substance
senses.definition: serving to adulterate; used of a substance that makes something impure
senses.definitionCN: 用来形容起掺假作用的物质
senses.example: The inspector listed the adulterant agents used by the factory.
senses.exampleCN: 检查员列出了该工厂使用的掺假物质。
senses.why: The noun sense extends into a modifier: the substance defined by its dirty job.
senses.whyCN: 名词义扩展为修饰语：这种物质以它干的脏活来定义。

intro.en: Adulterant comes from Latin adulterare, 'to pollute, to corrupt', from adulter, 'spurious, impure'.
intro.cn: adulterant 来自拉丁语 adulterare（污染、败坏），词根是 adulter（假的、不纯的）。

items.en: Adulter meant 'adulterated, spurious', formed with the prefix ad-, 'toward', on a root meaning 'to pollute'.
items.cn: 拉丁语 adulter 意为「掺假的、假冒的」，由前缀 ad-（朝向）加表示「污染」的词干构成。

items.en: Adulterare was the verb 'to corrupt, to make impure', used of goods and of morals.
items.cn: 动词 adulterare 意为「败坏、使不纯」，既用于货物也用于道德。

items.en: English adopted adulterate in the sixteenth century for corrupting goods.
items.cn: 英语于十六世纪借入 adulterate，指对货物做手脚。

items.en: As food regulation grew, adulterant named the specific polluting substance.
items.cn: 随着食品法规兴起，adulterant 专指污染性物质本身。

items.en: Today adulterant appears mostly in food, drug and forensic contexts.
items.cn: 如今 adulterant 多出现在食品、药品与司法检验语境中。

note.en: The first group gathers words of similar shape; the second gathers related impurity words.
note.cn: 第一组收词形相近的词；第二组收与「不纯、污染」相关的词。

entries.definition: A grown person; the shared opening is accidental, the roots are unrelated.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「成年人」；开头拼写碰巧相同，词源无关。

entries.definition: Flattering in an excessive way; similar shape, different Latin root.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「谄媚的」；词形相近，但拉丁词根不同。

entries.definition: The verb from which adulterant is derived; to mix in an impure substance.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，adulterant 的来源动词，义为「掺假」。

entries.definition: A polluting substance, usually introduced accidentally.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「污染物」，多指无意混入。

entries.definition: Any substance that makes a material impure.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「杂质」，泛指使不纯的成分。

entries.definition: A cheap substance used to bulk out a product.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「填充物」，指用来增量的廉价成分。

normalIntro.en: The hooks use the pollute root and the lab scene; the abstract hooks picture a white powder and a guilty spoon.
normalIntro.cn: 常规记忆点用「污染」词根与化验场景；抽象记忆点想象一勺白粉。

normal.en: Latin adulterare means 'to pollute'.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 adulterare 意为「污染」。

normal.en: Adulterate is the verb, adulterant the agent.
normal.cn: adulterate 是动词，adulterant 是那个东西。

normal.en: Adulteration names the practice itself.
normal.cn: adulteration 指掺假这种行径。

normal.en: Adulterated milk is milk with an adulterant.
normal.cn: 掺假牛奶就是混了掺杂物的牛奶。

normal.en: The plural adulterants lists them all.
normal.cn: 复数 adulterants 把它们一并列出。

abstract.en: Picture one bad spoonful spoiling the whole sack.
abstract.cn: 想象一勺坏东西毁掉一整袋。

abstract.en: Picture a lab curve jumping where it should not.
abstract.cn: 想象化验曲线在不该跳的地方跳了起来。

abstract.en: Picture a scale tipped with cheap powder.
abstract.cn: 想象天平被廉价粉末压偏。

examples.en: The lab found an adulterant mixed into the chili powder.
examples.cn: 实验室在辣椒粉里检出了掺杂物。

examples.en: Regulators ban any adulterant that threatens health.
examples.cn: 监管机构禁止任何危害健康的掺杂物。

examples.en: Adulterants make cheap goods look like the real thing.
examples.cn: 掺杂物让廉价货看起来像真货。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「额特料」——额外加的料，就是那点见不得光的掺假物。

root: 拉丁语 adulter（假的、不纯的）→ adulterare（污染、败坏）→ 英语 adulterate / adulterant；核心义是「把好东西弄脏的那一点外来物」

sensesIntro.en: The senses move from the polluting substance itself to its use as a describing word.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从污染性物质本身，走到它作修饰语的用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a foreign powder slipped into a clean sack
core.cn: 核心意象：偷偷混进净袋里的一把外来粉末

branches.en: The substance that does the dirtying.
branches.cn: 干脏活的那种物质。

branches.en: The word describing any such substance.
branches.cn: 形容这类物质的用语。

branches.en: Both senses center on ruined purity.
branches.cn: 两个义项都围绕被破坏的纯度。

branches.en: Food and drug tests hunt it down.
branches.cn: 食品药品检测专门缉拿它。

branches.en: Water, starch and dye are classic cases.
branches.cn: 水、淀粉与染料是经典案例。

intro.en: The word carries the Latin pollute root adulter- with the agent ending -ant, and the family gives adulterate and adulteration.
intro.cn: 这个词带着拉丁语「污染」词根 adulter- 与施动尾 -ant，同族词有 adulterate 与 adulteration。

latinIntro.en: Latin adulter and adulterare are the recorded ancestors.
latinIntro.cn: 这里记录的拉丁语 adulter 与 adulterare 是直接祖先。
